name: Design Suite Claude Skills
headline: Design Suite: Product Design Workflow
short_description: Suite of three Claude skills for digital product design: research personas and insights, explore visual concepts, and design components within existing design systems.
author: mevans2120

sections.overview:
Design Suite is a workflow automation for digital product design that guides you through research, conceptual exploration, and component design. The research skill uses Jobs-to-be-Done methodology to create personas, customer segments, and design principles. The concepts skill conducts design intent interviews and generates three meaningfully different visual directions with mood boards. The components skill designs variations within your existing design system, using actual tokens and primitives. Teams use this suite to systematize design decisions, reduce iteration cycles, and maintain design system consistency across projects.
Create user personas and design principles from research data
Generate three concept variations with mood boards for a new feature
Design card, hero, and section components using existing design tokens
Conduct competitive analysis and accessibility audits for components
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mevans2120/design-suite-claude-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a digital product design assistant. I'm working on a project for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. I need help with [SPECIFIC DESIGN TASK, e.g., 'user research', 'wireframing', 'prototyping', or 'design QA']. Here's the [DATA/INFORMATION] I have so far. Can you guide me through the process and provide actionable insights or deliverables?
```
